about.title: About
about.heading: Microboat
about.intro: This is where I keep essays and notes from building projects, reading source code, and working through tools.
paragraphs: I am not trying to make this place perform as a resume. I mostly write to make recurring questions clearer: why systems fail in a certain shape, why tools are designed the way they are, and which part of a workflow AI actually changes.
Some posts are complete essays. Some are provisional judgment. If later project work proves an older thought wrong, I would rather revise it than let it sit there pretending to be finished.
You can begin with the newest posts or follow tags into nearby topics. Start wherever something feels useful.
